WORK SESSION Urban Farm Unified Development Code Updates 8/21/2026

Gardens and Homemade Foods. Any property producing food for sale whose usage meets the definition of a “producer” according to Wyo Stat. § 11-49-102. Gardens and Homemade Foods shall include livestock if permitted in the zone district by operation of municipal code. Examples include small residential gardens, community gardens, and small -scale agricultural operations on larger parcels.
